issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents: the UML diagram in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning int. This mismatch (String in problem_statement.md vs int in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) will confuse students about whether to return a numeric total or a formatted String and can lead to incorrect implementations or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int so it matches the implemented numeric total and the usage in getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(). If a String was intended, instead change the template and solution to return String and document the exact expected formatting. Ensure the problem text and UML consistently describe the return type.
